name: set-clipboard-escapes-metacharacters
note: argv captured from buildSetClipboardCommand("hello; rm -rf / && echo 'pwned'"): ['cmd', 'clipboard', 'set', <escaped text>]. escapeShellArg wraps the whole text in single quotes, so the raw ';' and '&&' stay inside one argument instead of becoming separate tokens, and each embedded single quote becomes '\'' (close quote, escaped quote, reopen). The text and argv came from a real execution, not from reading the helper.
